pr.title: Make the inbox a list of changes waiting for you, not comments waiting for a response
pr.body:
Closes #108.

The inbox lists the changes waiting for you. The headline counts branches changed since you last looked, and says "Nothing new since you last looked" when there are none. Changed branches come first, each showing what it changes against its base and when it last moved. Opening a branch marks it as looked at until it gets another commit.

## What changed

- **Looked at:** opening a branch in the workspace, except on a background refresh, sends `POST /api/looked?repo&ref&tip` with the tip the page showed. The route refuses other sites, accepts only a real branch (`show-ref --verify`), and stores the tip in a new `looked` table (`lib/looked.ts`). If the watch stream's refresh replaces the first load, that refresh sends the mark instead.
- **Store:** version 4. `lib/upgrades/4.sql` adds `looked`, and new databases are created with it. Every branch reads as changed on the first run, since nothing has been looked at yet.
- **Rows:** each row has `changes` (commits, files, `+/−` against its PR's base, or the default branch without a PR) and `changed`. Changed means the branch's tip isn't the one you last opened and it has commits past its base. Merged and closed PRs, the default branch and detached worktrees never count as changed.
- **Order:** changed first, then newest commit (by time, not by the date's text), with merged and closed last. Children in a stack follow the same order, and repos are ordered by how many changed branches they have. Rows with no PR no longer sort below open PRs.
- **Inbox UI:** a filled dot for changed and an outline for looked at. The right column shows `+A −D`, "F files · C commits", when it last moved, and "new since you looked". A row with no commits past its base shows only when it last moved.
- **Removed:** GitHub's unresolved count, the `reviewThreads` field in the inbox query, the "N unresolved" text and its sort.
- **Docs and architecture:** `using-backstory.md`, `how-it-works.md`, `language.yaml` and `primitives.yaml` describe the inbox as changes waiting for you.

## Tests

- `test/inbox.test.ts`: branches are changed before anything is looked at, the one marked at its tip isn't, and a new commit makes it changed again. Changed roots come before looked-at ones, and archived rows stay last. Counts are against main, or against the PR's base for a stacked branch. The default branch has no counts and is never changed. Rows order by commit time across UTC offsets.
- `test/looked.test.ts` (new): a mark is read back, a second mark replaces it, and two repos with the same branch name don't share one.
- `test/store.test.ts`: a version-3 database upgrades to 4 with an empty `looked` table and keeps its other rows. A new database starts at 4.
- `test/api.test.ts`: `/api/looked` refuses other sites, answers 400 without a repo or branch or for a revision like `main~1`, and stores the page's tip, or the branch's tip when the tip is empty.

Checked by hand on the dev server: the headline, the dots and the right column, and opening a changed branch then going back shows it as looked at.

description.what: Replaces the inbox's unresolved-comment counts with a list of branches that changed since you last opened them, each row showing commits, files and lines against its base. Adds a `looked` table, `lib/looked.ts` and `POST /api/looked` to record the tip of a branch when the page opens it.
description.why: The inbox becomes a list of changes waiting for you instead of comments waiting for a response.

lookFirst.name: Inbox and repo discovery
lookFirst.reason: `counted` and `changesFrom` in `lib/inbox.ts` decide `changed` from the stored tip, the base ref and two git calls, and `nest` now orders rows by `changed` then commit time.

lookFirst.name: API routes
lookFirst.reason: `app/api/looked/route.ts` validates `ref` and `tip` and chooses which tip gets stored, and `app/page.tsx` decides when the page calls it.

components.name: API routes
components.sentence: Adds `POST /api/looked`, which checks the request is same-site, validates `ref` with `show-ref` and an optional `tip` as a full SHA, and calls `markLooked`.

components.name: App shell and shared UI
components.sentence: Makes `app/page.tsx` post the tip it showed to `/api/looked` once per foreground load, tracked by `lookPending`, even when a background refresh supersedes that load.

components.name: Inbox and setup screens
components.sentence: Changes `Inbox` to headline the count of changed branches and `InboxRow` to show additions, deletions, files, commits, last commit time and a "new since you looked" marker in place of the unresolved count.

components.name: Inbox and repo discovery
components.sentence: Drops review-thread counts from `lib/inbox.ts`, adds `changes` and `changed` to `InboxRow` computed from local git against the PR base or default branch, and sorts changed rows first by commit time.

components.name: Looked-at branches
components.sentence: Adds `lib/looked.ts` with `markLooked` and `lookedTips`, keyed by the repo's common git dir and branch, plus tests for both.

components.name: Local store
components.sentence: Adds the `looked` table to `lib/schema.sql` and an upgrade in `lib/upgrades/4.sql`, and raises `VERSION` in `lib/store.ts` to 4.
